newsitem.title: USA: Teva's Copaxone MS drug launched.
newsitem.headline: Teva's Copaxone MS drug launched.

text.p: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd said Wednesday that it's Copaxone treatment for multiple sclerosis which was shipped into distribution in late March, is officially launched.
Copaxone is being marketed in the U.S. by Teva Marion Partners, a partnership between Teva and Hoechst Marion Roussel, an affiliate of Hoechst AG.

Hoechst Marion Roussel, which is responsible for the distribution of the drug, is making it available to patients through both traditional retail pharmacy distribution and direct to patients through an arrangement with Caremark International, a unit of MedPartners Inc.
